findings.title: Fire as light, contact, and mark
findings.claim: Within the pericope, the fire over the condemned group remains destructive while also becoming a point of visibility and contact: it can illuminate, offer the image of familiar rest, and leave a mark when applied to the body.
findings.mechanism: The focus noun نار carries the registered light and burning-fire branches, the 90:16 occurrence مسكين supplies the nominated rest-and-comfort contact, and the preposed عليهم supplies the people receiving the fire's contact. Their meeting changes the fire from a merely enclosed blaze into a visible, contacting presence whose effect can also be read as a mark.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can feel how the fire is simultaneously seen, approached as a source of familiarity, and brought into bodily contact with the group named by the pronoun.
findings.containment: The focus still says that a fire is over them and sealed. Comfort and branding are contextual resonances of the fire image; no benign fire scene or literal animal-branding event is asserted.

epistemic.reason: The channel nomination is supported by exact focus and pericope contacts, while the rest-and-comfort branch is a nominated source image rather than an independently registered focus lexicon branch.
